gen-gf-baumans-gf-slabo-13px: Baumans draws a wide-open crescent of a c in lines of uniform thickness. Slabo 13px, a bookish serif with clear openings in its rounded letters, is happiest at a modest size, where those openings still do their job.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified and a touch editorial, Suwannaphum lifts its x-height like a squared-off woodblock letter. And Baumans brings a distinctive, uniform-stroke look that the body's high build sets off nicely.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab leaves a visibly gaping c at any size, with rounded lowercase standing high. Epunda Slab then sits under Bellota, whose single-width strokes and far-hanging s ends keep the heading looking distinctive.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-fauna-one: Literary and dignified, Fauna One is a serif with a generous entry into the e's eye. Fauna One can hold the quiet text while Bellota, with far-hanging s ends and one stylus width, takes large, brief lines.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, its big counters and wide, unclosed mouths keeping every line open. And Glegoo can drop to a modest size under Bellota's bent-wire headings without losing its openness.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-kadwa: Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine. Kadwa, a serif with open-ended curves and a large x-height, makes extended reading feel classic and unhurried, line after line.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads traditional and refined, with counters spilling into space. Bellota, with its marker-like line weight and far-hanging s ends, belongs in large, brief headings while its partner handles the rest.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-slabo-13px: Bellota draws everything at the width of one stylus, a level beat with no accents of weight. Slabo 13px does its best work in rounded letters whose openings stay clear and generous.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum lifts its x-height like a squared-off woodblock letter. Across many lines, its dignified, editorial voice stays steady beneath Bellota's constant stroke width, and the bent-paperclip c keeps the text moving.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-epunda-slab: Open, shade-free shapes lead, courtesy of Bellota Text. Epunda Slab follows with a visibly gaping c and rounded lowercase forms that make extended reading feel classic, dignified and unhurried.
